Each kind of building has its own district and the city fills up, by day and by night. Research, achievements that add production for good, meteor showers, a merchant, and colonies on six planets with Memories to spend on perks.
La nuit, la ville s’allume. Chaque succè: At night the city lights up. Each achievement adds 3 % production for good.
La ville produit des crédits chaque seco: The city makes credits every second, even when NeoDex is closed: on opening, all the time spent away is counted (since the last save, on any of your PCs). Each kind of building has its own district; every 25 of the same building, its production doubles. Research multiplies buildings and clicks, each achievement adds 3 % production for good. Click the city, the meteors, the yellow cargo ships and the merchant. After 1 trillion credits produced, "New colony" starts over on another planet with Memories to spend on perks. Day and night pass every 4 minutes. Saved and synced.
